Title: QR payload contains only name/studentId/program
Preconditions: Student account exists with full DB row (id, authUserId, email, role, createdAt)
Steps: Open Student's own QR/profile view and inspect generated payload
Expected Result: Payload JSON has exactly name, studentId, program - no id, authUserId, email, role, or createdAt

Title: QR payload is self-contained and offline-readable
Preconditions: Student has a valid QR code displayed
Steps: Decode QR payload without network access, parse JSON
Expected Result: Payload parses to valid name/studentId/program with no server lookup required

Title: QR Card reflects Student details at print time
Preconditions: Student has current name/Student ID/Program on record
Steps: Officer issues QR Card for Student
Expected Result: Card shows correct name, Student ID, Program, and embeds current QR payload

Title: Printed QR Card payload frozen after later correction
Preconditions: Student already has a printed QR Card
Steps: Officer corrects the Student's Student ID or Program afterward
Expected Result: Previously printed card's payload no longer matches current record and is treated as invalid for Scan Approval

Title: Worn school ID required alongside QR - card cannot self-corroborate
Preconditions: Student has both a worn school ID and a QR Card
Steps: Officer scans QR Card at booth
Expected Result: Scan Approval modal requires visual match against worn school ID, not the QR Card itself

Title: Readable QR with mismatched details is rejected
Preconditions: Student's QR payload does not match current Student record (name/ID/Program changed)
Steps: Officer scans the outdated QR
Expected Result: Approval is disabled; attempt is retained as a rejected Scan

Title: Student cannot access Officer/Governor pages
Preconditions: Signed in as plain Student (not promoted)
Steps: Navigate directly to booth scan screen or ADMIN page
Expected Result: Access denied / redirected

Title: Student views own Penalty/Ledger only
Preconditions: Student has Penalties across a Semester
Steps: Open dashboard/ledger view
Expected Result: Only own Attendance/Penalty/Payment data shown

Title: buildQrPayload strips extra fields from full DB row
Preconditions: Officer calls buildQrPayload with a full Student row (id/authUserId/email/role/createdAt included)
Steps: Generate QR payload for that Student
Expected Result: Output JSON contains only name/studentId/program; no leaked fields

Title: Officer can issue QR Card for any Student
Preconditions: Officer signed in; target Student exists
Steps: Search Student and issue QR Card
Expected Result: Card generated with correct current details

Title: Offline scan retains parsed Student details while pending sync
Preconditions: Mobile app offline; Officer scans a readable QR
Steps: Approve/reject the scan while offline
Expected Result: parseQrPayload returns Student fields (not just boolean); Recent Scans/pending entry shows name, studentId, program while awaiting sync

Title: Unreadable/malformed QR payload disables approval
Preconditions: QR payload is invalid JSON or missing a required field
Steps: Scan the malformed QR
Expected Result: isReadableQrPayload returns false; approval disabled; retained as rejection

Title: Duplicate scan UUID is a no-op
Preconditions: Scan already delivered and recorded with client UUID
Steps: Retry identical scan payload with same UUID
Expected Result: Backend returns success without reapplying attendance (no duplicate Attendance Session write)

Title: Same UUID with different content is rejected
Preconditions: Scan UUID already bound to a decision
Steps: Resubmit same UUID with changed content
Expected Result: Backend returns 409 Conflict

Title: Offline Scan Queue is partitioned per signed-in Officer
Preconditions: Two Officers use same device at different times
Steps: Officer A queues scans, logs out (after sync), Officer B signs in
Expected Result: Officer B does not see Officer A's queued/Needs Review items

Title: Logout blocked while pending or Needs Review items exist
Preconditions: Officer has pending Offline Scan Queue items or Needs Review decisions
Steps: Attempt logout
Expected Result: Logout blocked until delivered or explicitly discarded

Title: Officer corrects Student ID/Program directly, no approval workflow
Preconditions: Officer signed in; target Student record exists
Steps: Edit Student's Student ID and Program, save
Expected Result: Change applied immediately, no approval step, no audit trail recorded (per ADR-0014)

Title: Officer cannot access ADMIN (Governor-only) pages
Preconditions: Signed in as Officer (not Governor)
Steps: Navigate directly to ADMIN route
Expected Result: Server redirects Officer away from ADMIN page

Title: Officer can create/edit/delete any Event, not only own
Preconditions: Another Officer created an Event; current Officer signed in
Steps: Edit or delete that Event before any attendance activity
Expected Result: Edit/delete succeeds regardless of creator

Title: Governor can access ADMIN page
Preconditions: Signed in as Governor
Steps: Navigate to ADMIN route
Expected Result: ADMIN page loads successfully

Title: Governor promotes Student to Officer
Preconditions: Governor signed in; target is a plain Student
Steps: Search Student, promote to Officer role
Expected Result: Student's role becomes Officer; role-aware nav updates after re-sign-in/refresh

Title: Governor creates/edits/closes Semester
Preconditions: No open Semester or one open Semester exists
Steps: Create a new Semester with date range; later close it
Expected Result: Only one open Semester allowed at a time; closing freezes Event creation/definition, still allows attendance correction and Payment recording

Title: Semester dates cannot exclude existing Event
Preconditions: Semester has an Event dated within current range
Steps: Attempt to edit Semester dates to a range excluding that Event's date
Expected Result: Edit rejected/validated

Title: Governor manages Program list
Preconditions: Governor signed in
Steps: Add/remove a Program entry
Expected Result: Program list updates; reflected in Student registration options

Title: Governor can issue QR Card same as Officer
Preconditions: Governor signed in; target Student exists
Steps: Issue QR Card for Student
Expected Result: Card generated identically to Officer-issued card

Title: Governor retains all Officer capabilities
Preconditions: Governor signed in
Steps: Scan QR at booth, correct attendance, record Payment, check Clearance
Expected Result: All Officer actions succeed for Governor too

Title: Non-Governor cannot self-promote or access promotion UI
Preconditions: Signed in as Officer (not Governor)
Steps: Attempt to reach Student-promotion control directly
Expected Result: Action blocked/hidden - Governor-only
